CitedSource.description: One registered source, listed once per decision. Added in 1.4.
CitedSource.title: CitedSource

Compare.description: ``facet op value``; the value may be ``model(<id>)`` for a relative condition.
Compare.title: Compare

Decision.description: The engine's answer to one spec against one snapshot.
Decision.title: Decision

EvidenceQualifiers.description: Which evidence may satisfy a condition on an evidence facet.
EvidenceQualifiers.title: EvidenceQualifiers

InSet.description: ``facet in {a, b}`` or ``facet not in {a, b}``. Values are kept sorted and unique.
InSet.title: InSet

Known.description: ``known(facet)``: passes when the facet is known. It is never unknown itself.
Known.title: Known

ModelEliminationGroup.description: One eliminated model, with its model row or offering rows. Added in 1.6.
ModelEliminationGroup.title: ModelEliminationGroup

ModelRef.description: The right-hand side of a relative condition: ``coding >= model(openai/gpt-6-sol)``.
ModelRef.title: ModelRef

OfferingElimination.description: Why one offering of an eliminated model left the lineup. Added in 1.6.
OfferingElimination.title: OfferingElimination

Relaxation.description:
The smallest change to one numeric cap or floor that admits a model. Added in 1.5.

``condition`` is the spec's condition; ``relaxed`` is the same facet and
direction at ``value``, in ``unit``, the nearest value any excluded
candidate has; ``admits`` counts the models that then qualify.
Relaxation.title: Relaxation

Soft.description: A soft condition: violating it costs ``penalty`` of the objective instead of eliminating.
Soft.title: Soft

TaskTokens.description: How many tokens one task takes. ``offering.cost_per_task`` is priced from it.
TaskTokens.title: TaskTokens
